notes.title: Official Announcement - Release date postponed to May 16 and Devlog 1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494584/df49113e4b361fcab8b851f30597c68c84167c32.png[/img]

​[h3][b]📢 Official Announcement[/b][/h3]

Dear players,

We regret to inform you that the release of Better Mart, initially scheduled for May 2nd, will unfortunately need to be postponed to May 16.

This wasn’t an easy decision to make. Our initial version of the game included a set of planned features. However, following recent playtests and numerous pieces of feedback from the community — which we value deeply — we’ve come to realize that certain aspects of the game require more work to meet the quality standards we strive for.

We understand that this delay may cause disappointment, and not everyone will agree with our decision. But we firmly believe in choosing quality over speed. We’d rather take the extra time to deliver a solid, polished game than rush a release that doesn't reflect the full potential of Better Mart.

On a personal note, we’ve all experienced game launches where we felt things were missing — bugs, unfinished features, or promised content that only arrived in later updates. Often, we’ve thought: “I wish they had taken a little more time to get it right from the start.” That’s the kind of situation we’re trying to avoid.

Now, rest assured:

The multiplayer mode will be fully functional at launch, as promised.

A large number of new products will be available.

You’ll continue to unlock items, expansions, and much more — all the way up to level 100, with plenty of surprises along the way.

We sincerely apologize for this unfortunate news, and we hope you’ll understand our choice. Your support means the world to us, and we’re confident that this extra wait will make Better Mart a far better experience for everyone.

To keep you up to date with the game's progress, we've written a devlog, which you can find below.
